depiction.primary_object: two overlapping rectangular window frames with solid top bars
modifiers: diagonal slash from top-left to bottom-right
depiction.composition: two staggered overlapping windows struck through by a diagonal line

readings.meaning: block pop-up windows or disable multiple windows
close browser tabs or clean up open windows
disable screen sharing or window capture

ambiguity: Because the window title bar looks like the magnetic stripe on a card, the overlapping rectangles can easily be read as two bank cards being cancelled or blocked.

modifier_semantics.meaning: blocked, disabled, closed, or turned off

task_intents: stop apps from opening background windows

reasoning: The icon depicts two overlapping application or browser windows crossed out by a diagonal slash, representing blocked pop-ups, closed tabs, or disabled multi-window views. It fits a narrow niche of browser cleanup and UI configuration tasks, and at small sizes it can easily be mistaken for cancelled credit cards or unlinked duplicate files.
